_comment: SDF gallery artifacts — one full gallery (7 rows) + 7 per-row variants for VR performance testing and per-subject study.

graph_grammar_station.name: Graph Grammar Station
graph_grammar_station.description: In-VR live editor for graph-topology grammars. Seven preset buttons (Tree, Conifer, Autumn, Bush, Coral, Canopy, Bristle Ball) pick a graph recipe; up to four horizontal sliders tune that recipe's DNA (branch count, spread, depth, jitter, etc.); the graph rebuilds live on the central pedestal with bark + plant shaders. Godot-native counterpart to the web /graph-grammar-gallery.

form_studio_station.name: Form Studio Station
form_studio_station.description: In-VR form editor. Push-buttons pick a body recipe (flower, fungus, walker, tree, modulor, column, pedestal, amphora, ruin wall); up to four horizontal sliders drive that form's DNA genes; the body rebuilds live on the central pedestal. Native Godot counterpart to the web /form-studio.

sdf_gallery_room.name: SDF Gallery Room
sdf_gallery_room.description: Walkable exhibit of everything the SDF morphology system can produce — primitives, kingdom bodies, transitions, Modulor-scaled walkers, operator demonstrations, DNA variance, stacked operators. Seven rows extending north from the placement cell.

sdf_gallery_row_primitives.name: SDF Gallery — Primitives row
sdf_gallery_row_primitives.description: Row A only: capsule, ellipsoid, box, rounded box, cone, rotated box. Mesh rendering, one material. Lightest row; baseline for VR perf.

sdf_gallery_row_kingdoms.name: SDF Gallery — Kingdoms row
sdf_gallery_row_kingdoms.description: Row B only: tree, walker, flower, fungus — mesh bodies with per-slot shaders (plant, flesh, bark). Tests shader cost in VR.

sdf_gallery_row_transition.name: SDF Gallery — Transition row
sdf_gallery_row_transition.description: Row C only: flower↔fungus at five stops + LIVE animated morph. Heavy voxel-preview rebuild load (multiple per frame). The row most likely to stress VR FPS.

sdf_gallery_row_modulor.name: SDF Gallery — Modulor row
sdf_gallery_row_modulor.description: Row D only: walker at ladder rungs 0, 2, 4. Shows self-similarity at φ² scales. Three mesh bodies.

sdf_gallery_row_operators.name: SDF Gallery — Operators row
sdf_gallery_row_operators.description: Row E only: plain, +noise, +scales, +fold, +taper. Voxel previews of operator wrappers.

sdf_gallery_row_dna_variance.name: SDF Gallery — DNA variance row
sdf_gallery_row_dna_variance.description: Row F only: five flowers from the same recipe, different genes. Shows the 'kin but distinct' pattern.

sdf_gallery_row_stacked_ops.name: SDF Gallery — Stacked operators row
sdf_gallery_row_stacked_ops.description: Row G only: compound modifiers — noise+fold, scales+taper, flower fold, tree stripes, dots.
